observer.role: Track requirements, stage completion, reviewer findings, and final gate status.

source_inputs.story:
Option 4 locked story spine for @a.storyof.two Dot & Key brand integration.

Aachu likes Dot & Key, especially the blue Ceramides & Hyaluronic Barrier Repair Moisturizer. In their home, her night repair routine turns into a tiny teasing game.

She is expressive, strawberry-faced, and dramatic in the sweetest way. She cannot find her blue tube. Drawer search. Pouch search. Bathroom search. Wardrobe search. The whole room becomes an investigation.

Zuv is not doing a grand gesture. He is doing his usual quiet household-running thing. He watches the search, half amused, half ready. He opens the stock drawer and the backup Dot & Key Barrier Repair tube is already home.

The relationship truth: she lives here like a dramatic tenant of her own routine; he quietly runs inventory for the things that keep her okay.

Exact approved slide copy:
1. He didn't marry organized.
2. He married "maine yahin rakha tha."
3. He married drawer-searching.
4. Pouch-searching. Bathroom-searching.
5. And wardrobe-searching also.
6. Then he opened his stock drawer.
7. Her Dot & Key was already there.
8. Maybe love is knowing what she'll need before she does.

Product safety: show Dot & Key Barrier Repair as a loved, already-used routine product and backup household item. Do not make medical claims, before/after claims, cure claims, or imply the product fixes "strawberry face." Strawberry face is only Aachu's affectionate expressive identity cue.

requirements.label: Use romantic watercolor-and-ink / identity-rooted illustration style
Final prompts stay scene-first in the @a.storyof.two house style
Preserve supplied photo cues, outfits, settings, poses, and relationship energy
Aachu/Zuv identity reference is present in manifest and prompt pack
Identity dossier, preflight checklist, and face contact sheet are present before image generation
Face structure, expressions, clothing, and cross-slide identity continuity are reviewed before image generation
Run the post-copy visual creative room after approved copy and before prompt/image handoff
Per-slide visual screen passes before image generation
Create an approved 4-10 slide carousel arc, matching prompt count
Successful carousel standard is carried as open agent alignment and passes before final approval
Final generated carousel images are packaged as separate native 4:5 and 9:16 outputs, not local placeholders
Default final slides include rendered copy and brandmark inside both final/ and final-reels-stories/
Structured face and storyboard visual QA gate passes with evidence
Keep @a.storyof.two as a tiny, low-contrast bottom-right brandmark
Block photorealism, 3D rendering, generic stock couple art, and quote-card layout
Enrich wiki, index, working memory, and graph memory after the run

notes: No story photos supplied; identity references and the creative brief are the source of truth.
Wiki and memory files are updated after final audit generation.
